summary: The proof correctly derives joint continuity of the cap-area functions, applies the accepted slice-depth formula on fixed compact parameter sets, obtains continuity of M and Psi and the exact decomposition (1), establishes the finite right derivative of the Minkowski-interpolation area, and exhaustively derives the three active-set right-derivative identities. All hypotheses, strict-inequality persistence arguments, and liminf manipulations are valid, including endpoint and switching-maximizer cases.
